verdict.rationale: SendGrid documents regional email sending in the EU through a dedicated EU API base URL for regional subusers, so customers can choose a region. The docs describe regional sending rather than explicitly stating where data is stored at rest, and the option is limited to the EU on the Pro plan or above. missing for 10: explicit data-at-rest residency guarantees, regions beyond the EU, availability on lower plans, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Regional Email sending in the European Union (EU) is available for Twilio SendGrid Pro plan or above.
Base url: https://api.eu.sendgrid.com (for EU regional subusers)
